input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 19, 159 Juniper Mews, Kingshaven, ZZ9 2ZZ – ref R/PM033-1

Your landlord has agreed for us to instruct a plumber to look at the bathroom tap that squirts water when the shower is running. We are now arranging a contractor, who will contact you to agree a time to attend. We will update you again within 2 working days.

In the meantime, please keep use of the shower to a minimum, wipe up any water so it doesn't reach the floor or seep through, and if the leak becomes heavy or won't stop, turn off the water at the stopcock or isolation valve and contact us straight away.

It would help if you could reply with your availability for access over the coming days.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
